canonical_project: Vihiga County Government Data Centre (GIS/evidence-based planning facility)
notes: County-government GIS/data facility at Mbale used for evidence-based planning and county data management; 2026 reporting (Talk Africa) describes the county leveraging the Vihiga Data Center and confirms all 47 counties have established GIS database systems. Vihiga CIDP/ADP documents reference data-centre establishment/planning. Recorded as a government GIS/data centre separate from commercial colocation per KE methodology; no public MW capacity or commercial hosting evidence.
